enrichment.summary: Enables the admin consent workflow, allowing users to request access to applications requiring admin consent instead of being silently blocked.
enrichment.rationale: This policy ensures that users can request access to necessary applications while maintaining administrative oversight, minimising disruptions to productivity and enhancing security by controlling app permissions.
enrichment.userImpact: Users can submit requests for admin consent when attempting to access restricted applications.
prerequisites: Configured reviewers for admin consent requests
